about: YAML dialect cases for internal/yamlx: each case parses yaml and expects either json, the exact JSON text of the value, or error, a substring of the error message.
spec names the catalogue case (SY-9/a to SY-9/c) or, for cases that extend the catalogue, the finding SY-9; rule groups the cases.

Expected json values and every cli field were observed with npm yaml 2.8.3, the library SY-9 names, as a black box: JSON.stringify(YAML.parse(yaml)) with !inline and !inline_fileset resolving to the tag, a space and the scalar. None was recorded on a running Windmill.
policy cases are inputs windmill-lite refuses by its own rule; cli records what the CLI's parser returns for the same input, which for all but the alias-expansion case is a value.
